test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, each has got different marks in the board examination. P scored higher than only U and R. R scored higher than U. Q scored higher than S but lesser than T. T has not scored the highest among all. How many persons scored between Q and R?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) P scored higher than **only** U and R ⇒ **P** > U and R 

2) R scored higher than U ⇒ **R **> U

3) Q scored higher than S but lesser than T ⇒ T > **Q** > S

5) T has not scored the highest among all

So, the correct order will be ⇒ V > T > Q > S > P > R > U 

So, there are two persons who scored between Q and R.

Hence, the option 2 is the correct answer.
